build.prompt_version: Trump Diary — Weekly Thread Package Prompt v1

week.headline: The thirty-fifth week of Trump’s second term did not hinge on a single order or speech.
week.summary: The thirty-fifth week of Trump’s second term did not hinge on a single order or speech. It unfolded as a dense pattern of moves that treated security, law, and memory as tools to be shaped by the presidency. National Guard deployments, immigration raids, media pressure, and economic decrees all moved through formal channels, yet together they marked a further slide toward a system in which power answers less to institutions and more to one man’s sense of threat and advantage. week_summary_notes: Week 35 is best understood as a convergence week: security force deployment, immigration enforcement, legal instrumentalization, media pressure, and economic decrees all reinforced one another.
The week does not seem to turn on a single spectacular event; its significance lies in cumulative normalization of personalist rule through formal state channels.
Domestic militarization and immigration control should be tightly linked in the rewrite, since raids and Guard deployments appear as mutually reinforcing parts of one coercive method.
Executive overreach should function as the constitutional connective tissue rather than as an abstract standalone topic.
Information control matters this week chiefly because media pressure helps manage visibility and memory around coercive actions.
Some year-wide threads remain relevant as backdrop, but the rewrite should stay disciplined and avoid overloading the chapter with every available continuity strand.

rewrite_guidance.opening_focus: Open on the week as an accumulation of formally lawful moves—Guard deployments, raids, pressure campaigns, and decrees—that together reveal a presidency using the machinery of state as an integrated coercive system.
rewrite_guidance.closing_focus: Close by emphasizing that the week’s danger lay in normalization: institutions still functioned on paper, but increasingly as channels for one man’s definition of threat, loyalty, and advantage.
continuity_emphasis_notes: Stress continuity from prior weeks in the fusion of immigration enforcement with domestic security logic.
Present executive overreach not as a separate abstract argument but as the structure joining security, legal, administrative, and media actions.
Note that information control this week is important because it stabilizes and obscures coercive rule, not because symbolism or propaganda alone dominated events.
If resistance is mentioned, frame it as notably weak or absent in the week’s visible action.
Avoid scattering attention across too many secondary threads; this chapter should feel concentrated around coercive state integration.
